g.text: Full-data wall convergence in all measured contexts
8/8 saved context curves. Each band contains all five frequencies, four sources and twelve receivers; no averaging over contexts.
The refinement changes field mesh and interface geometry together. These are consistency differences, not continuum PDE error bounds.
